name: Ascend and Fall
description:
About This Game

Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

Your spell order matters. Aim for synergistic combos, stack debuffs, heal up to stay alive, or go for big damage bursts. Lock in your spell rotation and watch the fight auto-resolve, spell by spell. Choosing the right spells to cast at the right time makes the difference between life and death.

Choose one of four heroes, each with a set of signature spells to choose from. Select your loadout and discover new spells across your encounters with multiple tiers to unlock. Every hero plays differently, with one to match every playstyle.​

Your health and mana don't reset between fights; they carry through the whole climb. Every monster you hunt for loot is a wager, and every fight you take is a risk. Do you use your resources early for greater rewards, or save them for the rival waiting in the arena?

  • 4-slot spell bar where cast order decides the duel

  • 4 heroes, each with 7 signature spells

  • 25+ support spells, with upgrades for each

  • 30+ challenging creatures to slay

  • 35+ unique items to loot

  • Draft your spells for head-to-head fights against players

  • Health persists throughout your run, manage it wisely

  • Climb the ranks, one run at a time

  • Free to play

The wishlist button is right above this description. If you enjoy fast decision-making, clever spell combos, and outplaying opponents with pure strategy, add the game to your wishlist to get notified the moment we launch.
